info.name: Descartes MacroPoint Capacity Integration
info.description:
Descartes MacroPoint provides multiple options to create a functional and robust integration maximizing scalability and value. These integrations power the Descartes MacroPoint Capacity product. Documentation for the API and Flat File integrations can be found on the left side under the designated folder.

Data Requirements:

Initial Dataset

One Year Delivered Loads File

Continuous Data Requirements

Complete Carrier List - Sent on 24 hour frequency

Open Loads - Sent on 15 minute frequency

Booked Loads- Sent on 15 minute frequency

Delivered Loads - Sent on 15 minute frequency

*Please Note: Only send changes for each load type. Not a complete list on each post.

Request Structure

HTTP Method POST
Authentication Basic Auth
Content Type APPLICATION/JSON
Response Format JSON
Header Encoded

Carrier Import Request Schema

Name Name Description Value Example Required
Status Indicates carrier's active status within company Active Yes
DOTNumber Registered FMCSA USDOT number of carrier 123456 Yes
MCNumber Registered FMCSA MC Number of carrier. Format: MC prefix required, six digit number required. If carrier has an MC number less than six digits leading zeros must prefix number MC987654 Yes
Name Carrier name Awesome Trucking Co. Yes
OwnerName Account representative/owner within customer's organization John Doe No
DNU Allows the carrier to be flagged as Do Not Use Must be 'yes' or 'no' No
Favorite Allows the carrier to be flagged as a Favorite Carrier Must be 'yes' or 'no' No
CarrierContact: Name Main point of contact at carrier Bob Doe No
CarrierContact: Email Main point of contact email address bob@trucking.com Yes
CarrierContact: Phone Main point of contact phone number. Acceptable formats: 1234567890, 123-456-7890, or 1-234-567-8910 1234567890 Yes
CarrierContact: PhoneExtension Main point of contact phone number extension. Acceptable formats: x1234 or 1234 1234 No

Name Name Description Value Example Required

Load Import API request allows customers to post all load types

The more information supplied the better the user experience

MPLoadID Descartes MacroPoint Visilbity MPOrderID used for tracking String FB93D3FE546749F5A3385D1E2961A12B No

State - 64*

Postal - 16*

Commodity User Interfce Dispaly Field: Commodity of load String Produce No 200*

request.description:
The Find Power API allows for companies to receive a listing of top carriers ranked based on the lane and projected open capacity of the shipment. Additional parameters can be sent on the call allowing to factor in expanded radiuses, extended history, sub equipment, and expanded hours around appointment times to open the search to a wider carrier pool.

Production: https://dw-export-capacity.macropoint.com/api/v3/LSPFindPowerExportV3

Request Structure

Title Description
HTTP Method GET
Authentication Basic Auth
Content Type APPLICATION/JSON
Response Format JSON
Header Encoded

Response Schema

Name Name Description
AvgRatePerMile The average rate per mile (excluding fuel) across all carriers in the Find Power results if included on Import API
Carriers The list of carriers ranked in order of best match for the open load (100 or less will be returned)

Indivual Carrier Details included in Response Schema

Name Name Description
status Carrier status in customer's network, active or inactive
dot DOT Number for this carrier
mc MC number for this carrier (may be empty)
name Carrier's Name
r Rank for this carrier
lanescore Lane Score for this carrier
additionalcontacts Any additional contacts an LSP user has manually associated with this carrier, via the MP Capacity UI
sharedcontact The "best" email and/or phone number to reach this carrier, calculated by MP Capacity
ownercontact The person at the LSP who is associated as this carrier's relationship contact
carriercontact Includes contact information for all carriers (name, email, phone number)

Frnd Power Response Schema

request.description:
Single Carrier Information API allows customers to receive detailed information around a specific carrier including contact information, carrier lane history, forward looking capacity, deadhead averages, and carrier safety ratings.

Request Structure

Title Description
HTTP Method GET
Authentication Basic Auth
Content Type APPLICATION/JSON
Response Format JSON
Header Encoded

Response

AvgRatePerMile: The average rate per mile (excluding fuel) across all carriers in the Find Power results

PercentOfHistoryFromCoOp: Percent of customer's historical lane results coming from Capacity CoOp

Carriers: A list of carriers ranked in order of best match for the open load (100 or less will be returned)

Per Carrier

  • status: Carrier status in customer's network, active or inactive

  • dot: DOT Number for this carrier

  • mc: MC number for this carrier

  • name: Carrier's Name

  • r: Rank for this carrier

  • laneScore: Lane Score for this carrier

  • s: Statistics related to this carrier, as follows:

    • flc: Number of Trucks (Forward Looking Capacity) this carrier has that are near your open load's pickup
      • These are determined by the origin.datetime, originMilesRadiusWindow, and timeWindowBeforeOriginAppointment
    • t: Number of total historical trips related in some way to this open load (either the pickup location or destination location)
      • These are determined by originMilesRadiusWindow, destinationMilesRadiusWindow, and monthWindowForHistoricalData
    • dh: Average deadhead miles for the FLC for this carrier (i.e. average number of miles from the truck locations to the origin's pickup)
      • These are determined by the origin.datetime, originMilesRadiusWindow, timeWindowBeforeOriginAppointment and timeWindowAfterOriginAppointment
    • l: Number of Lane Matches in this carrier's history (i.e. number of times this carrier ran the same Origin to Destination route)
      • These are determined by originMilesRadiusWindow, destinationMilesRadiusWindow, and monthWindowForHistoricalData
    • d: Number of times this carrier has stopped in this destination
      • These are determined by destinationMilesRadiusWindow and monthWindowForHistoricalData
    • rl: Number of Reverse Lane Matches in this carrier's history (i.e. number of this times this carrier ran a Destination to Origin route)
      • These are determined by originMilesRadiusWindow, destinationMilesRadiusWindow, and monthWindowForHistoricalData
    • o: Number of times this carrier has started in this origin
      • These are determined by originMilesRadiusWindow and monthWindowForHistoricalData
    • r: The average rate per mile (excluding fuel) charged for this lane, if it has lane matches

  • carrierContact: Includes contact information for all carriers (name, email, phone number)

    • If the request contained a carrierDotNumber, the carrier contact information will be returned for just that carrier.

  • carrierRating: If the request contained a carrierDotNumber, the carrier rating information will be returned for just that carrier.

  • ownerName: The person at your LSP that owns this carrier (may be empty/missing)

  • trucks: This includes current GPS locations (latitude/longitude) of the relevant trucks (may be empty/missing)

                • These are determined by originMilesRadiusWindow, destinationMilesRadiusWindow, and monthWindowForHistoricalData

              • D: Number of times this carrier has stopped in this destination

                • These are determined by destinationMilesRadiusWindow and monthWindowForHistoricalData

              • RL: Number of Reverse Lane Matches in this carrier's history (i.e. number of this times this carrier ran a Destination to Origin route)

item.description: The Descartes MacroPoint Capacity Offer API provides customers and 3rd Party TMSs the ability to offer open loads to carriers, accept offers from carriers, and counter offers.

Descartes MacroPoint Capacity APIs are the premier form of integration and power the Descartes MacroPoint Capacity product. Below you will find documentation for integrating inbound data (Import API) to MacroPoint Capacity as well as how to receive carrier matches back to your system (Export API).

item.description:
Descartes MacroPoint offers customers the ability to upload the following updates via the Descartes MacroPoint FTP:

Upload Type Description
Carriers Upload all active & inactive carriers
Loads Upload open, booked, and delivered loads

Note: All column headers must be included for both Carriers and Loads files. If data is missing or unknown leave cell blank. Column header order does not matter.

File Upload & Authentication

All files should be uploaded to the FTP URL:

  • Production: ftp-capacity.macropoint.com

Descartes MacroPoint will provide you:

  • FTP User ID
  • FTP Password
